title: List visual review lifts on merge
description: Requests to lift a quarantine when this run's pull request merges, newest first. `state` is `pending` (waits for the merge and a default-branch run that renders `expected_hash` against a matching baseline), `applied`, `cancelled` or `superseded`. `detail` says what the latest check found. A lift never approves a picture. Empty for a run without a pull request.

methodDocumentation.text: Every request to lift a quarantine when this run's pull request merges, newest first, in any state. Empty for a run without a pull request.
